# The shaders of the page's prebuilt list, recorded by N64Recomp-browser's tools/record_shaders.mjs
# (tools/record_shaders.sh), a page load a section. Every load: the launcher, Load ROM on a new profile, Start Game,
# then Start (Enter) through the splashes and the title to the main menu, all of it section 0, built before the game
# starts. Then each of Season's twenty tracks is reached by A (Space) through Season's menus to rider select, with the
# race it starts put on the track (tools/shader_survey.js's setTrack(), as Season's round); each special track through
# the main menu's Special Tracks, its item opened and chosen (special()), Soccer's with two stand-in pads plugged in
# (N64Recomp-browser's tools/gamepad_probe.js), since it takes two players; and the tutorial as Season's difficulty
# popup's first choice (difficulty()). A section presses A into its race, past the track's intro to the countdown,
# holds the throttle for 40 s of it and opens the pause menu and closes it; Original Excitebike's starts its game and
# rides it for 30 s. The user track (the editor's) is left out: it is built from the outdoor tracks' pieces.
# Section 0 also holds six shaders split screens missed as Kyoto's intro started, before the track's section had come:
# five in the pads plan's (tools/play_plan_pads.json) four players' and one in two players'.
